fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Delhi Laxmi Yojana has started the online registration process for the Delhi Lakshmi Yojana from 1 August 2026. Under this scheme, eligible women will receive ₹2,500 financial assistance every month. According to the government, more than 17 lakh women are expected to benefit from the scheme. If you are also planning to apply, it is important to know the eligibility criteria, required documents, and application rules beforehand so that you can complete the registration process correctly and without any difficulty.

Delhi Laxmi Yojana 2026

Delhi Laxmi Yojana Form 2026

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 01 August 2026
  • Last Date : N/A

Application Fee

  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

Delhi Laxmi Yojana 2026 : Details

  • The Delhi Lakshmi Yojana aims to provide monthly financial assistance to economically weaker women and support their financial independence. The Delhi Government has allocated ₹5,110 crore for the scheme in the 2026–27 budget. Earlier known as the Mahila Samriddhi Yojana, the scheme has now been renamed Delhi Lakshmi Yojana. According to a notification issued by the Delhi Government’s Department of Women and Child Development on 6 August 2026, the scheme came into effect on 1 August 2026 and will initially remain operational for three years. Under the scheme, eligible women will receive ₹2,500 per month, which will be transferred digitally to their savings bank accounts. The scheme focuses on promoting women’s financial independence, decision-making ability, and self-reliance.

How Will Women Receive ₹2,500 Every Month?

  • Option : 1
  • ₹1,500 per month will be deposited into an RD (Recurring Deposit) or FD (Fixed Deposit) account.
    ₹1,000 will be provided through a CBDC (Central Bank Digital Currency) wallet, which can be used only to purchase essential items approved by the government.
  • Option : 2
  • Beneficiaries also have the option to have the entire ₹2,500 monthly assistance deposited directly into an RD (Recurring Deposit) or FD (Fixed Deposit) account

Delhi Lakshmi Yojana Form 2026 : Who Can Apply?

  • The applicant must be a woman between 21 and 60 years of age.
  • The family’s annual income must be ₹2.5 lakh or less.
  • The woman or her family must have been a resident of Delhi for at least 10 years
  • Only one woman per family can receive the benefits under the scheme.
  • Priority will be given to the oldest eligible woman in the family.

Delhi Lakshmi Yojana Form 2026 : Who Will Not Be Eligible?

  • Women who pay Income Tax are not eligible.
  • Women who file GST returns are not eligible.
  • Government employees or women whose family member works in a government department or PSU are not eligible.
  • Women already receiving benefits under another government financial assistance scheme are not eligible.
  • Families owning a four-wheeler vehicle are not eligible.
  • Families whose annual electricity consumption exceeds 2,400 units are not eligible.
  • Families having more than three children are not eligible.
  • Women with a criminal record are not eligible.

Delhi Lakshmi Yojana 2026 : Document Required

  • Aadhaar Card
  • Delhi Voter ID
  • Passport-size Photograph
  • Signature
  • Recommendation Letter from the Local MLA or MP

Delhi Lakshmi Yojana Form 2026 : How To Fill

  • Visit the official Delhi Lakshmi Yojana portal.
  • Click on New Registration and complete the registration process.
  • Verify your mobile number and Aadhaar details.
  • Enter all the required personal and family details.
  • Upload the necessary documents as required.
  • Select your preferred payment option — RD/FD or CBDC.
  • Review the application form carefully and submit it.
  • Download or save the application receipt for future reference.
  • Note: Candidates are advised to carefully read the official notification before submitting the application form. Make sure to check the last date, age limit, and eligibility criteria properly before applying.

Important Question

Q. What is Delhi Lakshmi Yojana?
Answer: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana is a financial assistance scheme introduced for eligible women in Delhi. Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries will receive ₹2,500 per month.

Q. When did Delhi Lakshmi Yojana 2026 come into effect?
Answer: The scheme came into effect on 1 August 2026.

Q. How much financial assistance will eligible women receive?
Answer: Eligible women will receive ₹2,500 every month under the scheme.

Q. Who is eligible to apply for Delhi Lakshmi Yojana?
Answer: Women aged 21 to 60 years, whose family’s annual income is ₹2.5 lakh or less, and who meet the prescribed Delhi residency and other eligibility conditions can apply.

Q. How will the ₹2,500 financial assistance be provided?
Answer: Beneficiaries can choose the payment option available under the scheme, including RD/FD deposits or a combination of RD/FD and a CBDC wallet, as per the applicable rules.

Q. How many women are expected to benefit from Delhi Lakshmi Yojana?
Answer: The scheme is expected to benefit more than 17 lakh women.

Q. What documents are required to apply for the scheme?
Answer: The listed documents include Aadhaar Card, Delhi Voter ID, passport-size photograph, signature, and a recommendation letter from the local MLA or MP.

Q. Can more than one woman from the same family receive the benefit?
Answer: No. Only one woman per family can receive the benefit, with priority given to the oldest eligible woman.

Q. Who is not eligible for Delhi Lakshmi Yojana?
Answer:Income-tax payers, GST return filers, certain government employee families, beneficiaries of other government financial assistance schemes, families owning a four-wheeler, and those falling under other specified exclusion criteria are not eligible.

Q. How can I apply for Delhi Lakshmi Yojana 2026?
Answer: Applicants need to visit the official Delhi Lakshmi Yojana portal, complete the registration process, verify their Aadhaar and mobile number, enter the required details, upload the necessary documents, select the preferred payment option, and submit the application.

Q. What is Delhi Lakshmi Yojana Official Website?
Answer. The Official Website of Delhi Lakshmi Yojana is https://dly.delhi.gov.in/
